voice_note_hostage_taker.description: Why type when you can hold everyone hostage with 3-minute voice notes? Your friends have learned to fear the blue waveform.

gif_archaeologist.description: You dig through the GIF vault for the perfect reaction. Words are optional when you have a GIF for everything.

snap_happy.description: You send photos of everything — food, sunsets, mirror selfies, random screenshots. Your camera roll IS the conversation.

video_virtuoso.description: Lights, camera, action! You communicate through videos and round video messages. A picture says a thousand words, but a video says a million.

file_fiend.description: PDFs, ZIPs, spreadsheets — you're the group's IT department. If it can be attached, you've sent it.

link_lobbyist.description: Always sharing articles, videos, and links. You're everyone's personal news feed and algorithm combined.

forwarding_machine.description: Why create content when you can redistribute it? Your chats are a curated feed of other people's messages.

sticker_merchant.description: Your sticker collection is legendary. Why use words when a perfectly chosen sticker conveys the exact emotion?

novelist.description: Short messages? Not your style. You write paragraphs that could fill a book. Each text is a chapter.

k_person.description: k. ok. ya. cool. You've mastered the art of saying everything with almost nothing.

midnight_dropper.description: The world sleeps but you're wide awake, dropping messages into the void at 3 AM. Sleep is for the weak.

normal.description: You're a well-rounded communicator who mixes text, media, and timing in perfect harmony. Boring? No — balanced.
